title: azorella cuneifolia
intro: Azorella cuneifolia, commonly known as Anzac pea or Rock pepper, is a type of flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Azorella cuneifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes are responsible for its medicinal properties.
